description: This file defines an 'InfiniteScroller' React component that provides infinite scrolling functionality with support for both vertical and horizontal directions. It manages scroll position, element visibility, and exposes an imperative handle for scrolling to specific elements. The component uses React hooks such as useRef, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback, and useImperativeHandle, and employs IntersectionObserver for lazy-loading and scroll event detection.

classes.name: InfiniteScroller
classes.description: React component implementing infinite scrolling with customizable pagination triggers, element visibility callbacks, and scrolling to specific elements via an imperative interface.

methods.name: scrollToElementId
methods.description: Scrolls the view to the DOM element with the specified ID.
